question: Sinch signup requires both a work email address and a 2FA-verified phone number. Which identity_cost.kind term fits a mandatory email plus mandatory phone?
why: The closed identity_cost.kind vocabulary has no combined email-and-phone term and no 'work email' term. Used 'any-phone' as the nearest term and named the email requirement in identity_cost.detail.

new.slice: Sinch signup requires both a work email address and a 2FA-verified phone number.
